The core insight is that settlement clearance is a dual-process system: root cause analysis (RCA) provides the explanatory framework, while straight-through processing (STP) enables automated resolution. The system operates under a health-based threshold where settlement-health must be 'HEALTHY' and net burn positive before declaring clearance. This dualism mirrors a Bayesian belief update: RCA provides likelihoods of root causes, while burn rate acts as a dynamic evidence accumulator. Failure modes include misclassification of root causes (e.g., undated ESPN board), which leads to persistent overdue picks. The integrity companions ensure data fidelity by preventing silent deletions and validating placebo leaks. The system’s resilience depends on iterative feedback loops between health checks and burn rate monitoring.
